rows.title: feat(types): Allow the Params property to be typed, instead of `any`
rows.model_rationale: This adds a new public generic type parameter `P` to `AxiosRequestConfig` and propagates it across the entire public TypeScript surface (AxiosResponse, AxiosError, CanceledError, AxiosPromise, request aliases, isCancel, isAxiosError, mergeConfig, CustomParamsSerializer, etc.), enabling typed query params where they were previously `any`. This is an additive public API change to the documented types, and the PR itself updated its changelog and docs-tracking file, confirming relevance.
rows.label_rationale: Adds a second generic parameter to AxiosRequestConfig/AxiosPromise/isCancel and propagates it through public type declarations (index.d.ts/index.d.cts). The PR itself edits PRE_RELEASE_DOCS.md with usage examples, confirming the maintainers consider this a documented public API surface change.

rows.title: fix(core): synthesize AxiosError message from AggregateError.errors
rows.model_rationale: This behavior fix changes the observable output of the documented AxiosError.from()/toJSON() surface: AggregateError-based network failures now surface a synthesized message instead of a blank one. The PR itself updated the changelog and flagged docs error-handling notes, confirming user-facing relevance.
rows.label_rationale: AxiosError.from() now synthesizes a .message from AggregateError.errors instead of leaving it blank, and toJSON() carries it. The PR updates PRE_RELEASE_CHANGELOG.md in the same diff, confirming the maintainers consider this a user-facing change worth describing.

rows.title: fix(helpers): correct data: URL base64 size estimate for maxContentLength guard
rows.model_rationale: This is a security/behavior fix that tightens the documented maxContentLength guard for data: URLs so oversized percent-embedded base64 bodies can no longer bypass it — a real change in observable behavior for a documented option. The maintainer also added a changelog entry, confirming user-facing relevance. The helper is an internal module, but the effect on maxContentLength enforcement is user-facing.
rows.label_rationale: Fixes how the documented maxContentLength option is enforced for data: URLs — previously percent-encoded input could bypass the configured limit. This changes observable behavior of a documented config option.

rows.label_rationale: Changes the documented contract for synchronous request interceptor error handling (paired onRejected semantics, when the request dispatches vs. rejects). PRE_RELEASE_DOCS.md is updated in the same diff with the exact behavior to document.

rows.label_rationale: cloneRawRequest is an internal helper (used by validators/testing utilities to re-read a consumed request), not a documented public API. The fix corrects an internal correctness bug without changing any documented contract.

rows.title: fix(v4): cidrv6 JSON schema pattern matches runtime
rows.model_rationale: The fix changes the JSON Schema `pattern` emitted by `z.toJSONSchema()` for `z.string().cidrv6()`, so consumers of the generated schema now get a pattern that accepts valid IPv6 CIDRs it previously rejected. This is an observable behavior change in a documented public feature (JSON Schema conversion), warranting a changelog/docs note.
rows.label_rationale: Fixes the cidrv6 regex used by the documented z.string().cidr({ version: 'v6' }) validator so it accepts valid CIDR v6 addresses it previously rejected (e.g. '2001:db8:1::/48'). Changes what input a documented string-format validator accepts.

rows.title: Tighten discriminated union option typing
rows.model_rationale: This is a compile-time-only type tightening of discriminatedUnion's generic constraint so option schemas must include the discriminator key. It changes TypeScript type-checking (now surfaces a type error) but does not alter runtime behavior, the public function signature usage, or documented API shape; changes are otherwise internal type refinements plus tests.
rows.label_rationale: Narrows a TypeScript generic constraint so z.discriminatedUnion() rejects, at compile time, an object option that's missing the discriminator key — a rare misuse case. No runtime behavior changes and normal documented usage is unaffected.

rows.title: fix(v4): reject tuple holes before required defaults
rows.model_rationale: This changes observable behavior of a documented public API (z.tuple parsing with optional/default elements): inputs like ["alpha"] against tuples with a defaulted trailing element now reject where they previously succeeded and truncated. That is a user-visible behavior change for valid documented usage, so a maintainer may need to describe it (e.g. changelog/tuple docs).
rows.label_rationale: Changes z.tuple()'s runtime parse behavior: an absent optional slot before a later required/defaulted output slot now correctly fails instead of silently truncating and materializing the default. This flips success/failure for real inputs against the documented tuple API.

rows.title: fix(v4): skip __proto__ key in object catchall
rows.model_rationale: This is a security fix changing how documented object methods (looseObject, passthrough, catchall, strict) handle a specific input shape (__proto__ key), preventing prototype pollution. Per the guidance, security fixes that change how a documented API handles a class of input warrant a docs/changelog note.
rows.label_rationale: Security fix closing a prototype-pollution vector in .passthrough()/.catchall()/looseObject() (linked GitHub security advisories). This changes documented-schema parsing behavior for a security-sensitive input and warrants a docs/changelog note.

rows.title: Make z.preprocess defer optionality to inner schema
rows.model_rationale: This changes documented behavior of z.preprocess: optionality now defers to the inner schema, so an object property using z.preprocess(fn, z.number().optional()) now correctly treats missing keys as valid (previously failed). It also introduces a new public export ZodPreprocess/$ZodPreprocess and the diff itself updates docs (core.mdx), confirming doc relevance.
rows.label_rationale: Introduces a new exported ZodPreprocess class and changes how z.preprocess()'s optionality is inferred from the inner schema. The PR itself edits packages/docs/content/packages/core.mdx, confirming it's a documented public API change.

rows.title: fix(v4): generalize optin/fallback to transform; restore preprocess on absent keys
rows.model_rationale: This changes observable runtime behavior of documented public APIs: standalone z.transform now accepts absent object keys, z.preprocess again works on absent keys (4.3 parity regression fix), and catch/transform/optional chains now clobber to undefined through pipe boundaries. These are real user-facing behavior changes to documented schema methods, warranting a changelog/guide note even though static types are unchanged. The wiki doc is internal-only, but the source changes are what matter.
rows.label_rationale: Changes how .optional() interacts with .catch()/.transform()/.preprocess() across pipe boundaries on absent input — a documented schema-composition behavior that previously produced wrong results (e.g. transform output leaking through an outer .optional()).

rows.title: Various tweaks

This changes observable behavior of documented features (prefixUrl, hooks, pagination, credential handling) for real users and warrants a docs/changelog note.
rows.label_rationale: Changes cross-origin redirect handling: which sensitive headers get stripped and when the request body is discarded/preserved after a beforeRequest hook changes the URL to a different origin. This is documented redirect/security behavior (see the cross-origin stripping notes in 2-options.md) being corrected.

These are user-facing API and behavior additions warranting doc updates.
rows.label_rationale: Adds a new supported HTTP method end to end (options type, aliases, redirect/body/cache handling). The PR itself updates five documentation files (2-options.md, 3-streams.md, 7-retry.md, cache.md, readme.md), confirming doc-relevance directly.
